newsitem.title: UK: Iran buys white, raw sugar in recent tender - trade.
newsitem.headline: Iran buys white, raw sugar in recent tender - trade.

text.p: Iran bought at least two cargoes of raw sugar at its recent tender and probably one cargo of white sugar as well, traders said on Tuesday.
Iran's GTC (Government Trading Corporation) paid between $257 and $258 a tonne for two 15,000-tonne cargoes of raws, said to be Cuban in origin, for March 15/April 15 shipment, they said.
Details on the whites purchase were more sketchy but traders said they believed Iran bought 14,000 tonnes for March shipment at around $302 per tonne.
The GTC issued an international buying tender on Monday.
